evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Calvin says 'I was just reaching out. I got the quote request here wondering if you had about ten minutes or so to just run through it' — no time-box framing, no promise of a dependable quote, no wait for a yes before moving to agenda probe.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Calvin asks 'and I guess before jumping in anything in particular about the move or any items you have that you're super concerned about that I could address' — phrased as a concern check, not the recognizable 'what are your biggest concerns' agenda frame, and the customer says no concerns exist, ending the probe.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer stated 'No we don't have anything like that' so no concerns were raised to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised, so no summary reflection was required or possible.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Calvin covers property type (two bedroom apartment, two story house), floor/stories (first floor apt, two-story house with stairs inside), number of rooms (two bedroom), walking distance (10 meters from parking), additional rooms and special considerations (upstairs smaller, most square footage on first floor, stairs in house but flat entry, truck parking assessment). Nearly all seven logistics items present.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Calvin discusses loose items and packing prep efficiency but never asks 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked. Calvin says 'Usually we see about 2530 boxes for a two bedroom apartment. Do you think that'll be about right for you?' Customer declines to commit on box count but the question was posed.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Calvin provides a range: 'typically for a two bedroom apartment it takes between three and a half and five and a half hours with a two man crew so the cost range is typically between $728 and, and on the higher end $1,144' and personalizes to this move: 'you know first floor only have a set of stairs at the house for probably just a few items going up there. So I would probably put you know in the middle lower end, probably around the 9:36 or you know, even three and a half hours if.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Calvin states 'We don't have any trip fees. We don't have any taxes or credit card fees' and 'We'll have tools. So, we can handle this assembly reassembly on things that needed. Like bed frames and everything's fully insured' and 'we do a 2.5 hour minimum which is $520. Once we exceed the minimum we just bill in fifteen minute increments until the move is completed.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After pricing delivery, the customer says 'Yeah, makes sense to me' but Calvin never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or similar closing question. The conversation moves directly to the customer's follow-up about notice period.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. Calvin states 'we do have an on time guarantee if we're ever late to a window of arrival that we give you. We do a discount your money back.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full. Calvin says 'we also like to mention provided within our hourly rate is our no worries damage coverage that allocates up to $2,000 per move. Just to give you a piece of mind, we cover damage as well above and beyond the industry standard which is 60¢ per pound. So we take care of everything to full resolution.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. After the two promises, the customer raises a new question ('How much notice do you all usually leave') and Calvin answers it, but Calvin never reflects back on the two promises or asks 'Does that put those to rest?' — the conversation shifts into logistics discussion instead of looping closed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. The call moves to 'I can send the quote over here in about a minute or two' without any version of 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variant is present.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Calvin says 'So, what I can do is, I can send the quote over here in about a minute or two with the details of the pricing' but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' — the ask for the business is completely absent; the call ends with an email offer.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes. Calvin says 'we don't have any deposits to book. We don't have any rescheduling or cancellation fee. So you're able to book whenever you want.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Calvin confirms the customer will receive a quote via email with 'a couple of questions at the bottom that we would need to answer to book it in' and says 'they're just a couple of questions at the bottom that we would need to answer to book it in. So you can just email those back or give us a call back whenever you want to get on the calendar.' However, no date, phone number, arrival window, crew size, or addresses are confirmed on this call; the booking is fully deferred to email follow-up.

top_strength: Calvin gathered full logistics details efficiently and delivered a personalized, anchored pricing range with transparent fee structure and both promises (On-Time and No Worries coverage) clearly framed.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — the call ended with 'I'll email the quote' instead of 'Would you like our help with your move?' and zero booking details were confirmed; also skip the quid-pro-quo framing at the start and always ask Their Agenda before jumping into logistics probing.
